name: N1291-DW9 (Hubble)
blurb: N1291-DW9, a dwarf elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: dw0309m4104-hubble
story: This faint dwarf galaxy was spotted in deep wide-field images around the galaxy NGC 1291. Hubble visited it as part of a census of the satellite galaxies of nearby Milky Way-like galaxies, resolving its stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: N1291-DW9 is a dwarf galaxy candidate found in deep wide-field images of NGC 1291
DW0309M4104 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy
DW0309M4104 is cataloged as a dwarf galaxy of elliptical morphology
Hubble program 18061 is a census of satellite galaxies within Milky Way-like systems
The program aims to resolve the dwarfs' stars to measure their distances
